notes:
Summary: Enterprise evaluation for Dedicated capacity with strong emphasis on deterministic latency and predictable unit economics. Primary workload: real-time support chat + reranking for search; embeddings for personalization.

Timeline (recent):
- 2024-10-28: Intro call, AE (Liam) + SE (Priya). High-level ask: p95 chat <= 120ms, baseline steady QPS 150, peak spikes up to 650 for seasonal campaigns.
- 2024-11-05: Data/traffic handoff; BluePeak shared sample traces (avg tokens/request ~ 80, 95th tokens/request ~ 380).
- 2024-11-12: Dedicated sizing workshop (2hr) — recorded (ff_2024-11-12_BluePeak_workshop). Reviewed model family preferences and fallback rules.
- 2024-11-18: Security questionnaire submitted; legal flagged SOC2/ISO clarifications. Jira SEC-701 opened.
- 2024-11-24: Pilot scope agreed: 8-week dedicated pilot with 72h throughput validation window and weekly checkpoints.

Technical requirements / workshop outputs (bulleted):
- Workload mix: 55% chat (conversational generation), 30% embeddings (batch offline + online), 15% reranking.
- Baseline QPS: 150 steady-state (business hours), token rate estimate: ~12k tokens/sec steady, burst peak token/sec estimate: ~52k tokens/sec.
- Latency SLOs: chat p50 < 60ms, p95 < 120ms (99th < 250ms preferred), embeddings batch latency tolerable up to 3s.
- Throughput guarantees: require contractual throughput floor for steady-state with burst headroom of 4-5x for seasonal peaks.
- Reserved GPU planning: workshop recommended starting pilot with 6 x H100-equivalent GPUs (mixed precision q4_0 quantized models for cost) and autoscaling policy with warm standby nodes (2) to handle sub-minute capacity scaling.
- Caching strategy: aggressive prefix/KV cache for recurring sessions and embedding embedding cache for common queries to lower token/sec sustained.
- Routing/fallback: primary model for low-latency queries + fallback smaller faster variant for overload; fallback needs quality validation set.

Negotiation points (SLA / commercial):
- Unit economics: BluePeak is cost-sensitive vs monthly reserved commitment. Asking for tranche pricing: steady state reserved + pay-as-you-burst with capped burst costs.
- SLA: uptime % and latency SLOs with credits; dispute adjudication path needs to be defined for burst-related failures.
- Security: require KMS integration for key ownership and audit logging retention 1 year, plus data residency (US) for PII.

Open actions / next steps:
- SE (Priya) to provide detailed per-model token/sec capacity table and run local perf bench by 2024-12-05.
- AE (Liam) to propose pilot T&Cs and reserved capacity options (3, 6, 12-month) by 2024-12-03.
- Legal to review SOC2 artifacts; BluePeak to provide SOC2 report or gap mitigation plan.
- Schedule 72h throughput validation window in dedicated pilot; define pass criteria (p95 <= 120ms for 95% of windows AND throughput floor sustained for 24h).

Stated customer quotes / paraphrases: "We need behavior to be predictable — surprises in token cost kill our unit economics".
